A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SCARED research work. All 19 pages of each version, including Appendices A–E, equations, tables and figures, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original return and cost experiments across five environments, budget-sensitivity evaluations, and baseline and ablation results in Figures 1–2 and 4–6.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and appendix results, including adaptation curves, budget-sensitivity evaluations and ablations.

M1.justification: The CTG-conditioned policy, exact-penalty objective, single-multiplier updates and actor-critic implementation remain unchanged in Section 4 and Algorithm 1. Newly reported parameter totals do not establish an architecture change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate SafeDarkRoom, SafeDarkMujoco Point and Car, and SafeVelocity HalfCheetah and Ant. The center-to-edge distribution shift and held-out velocity tasks are unchanged; v3 Table 1 summarizes existing coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain Safe AD, SafeMeta and MAML with penalty, AD versus AD-EPS in Figure 4, and the naive primal-dual comparator in Figure 5(c). Citation-year updates do not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 5.2 replaces SCARED's stated 30,000/10,000/1,000 training-step budgets with training to convergence, and Appendix C removes SCARED and Safe AD update-count rows. This revises the reported training protocol without establishing that experiments were rerun. Evaluation tasks, metrics and CTG sampling remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix C adds a limited full-pipeline resource comparison accounting for Safe AD's data collection and distillation versus SCARED's online pretraining. The noise-distillation comparison and context-length, model-size, dataset-size and optimization ablations in Figures 4–6 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Figures 1–2 retain the same standard-error reporting and averaging descriptions. Neither version adds training-seed counts, repeated-run procedures, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Appendix C newly reports approximately 4M versus 1M environment steps and 25M versus 6M parameters for Safe AD versus SCARED on SafeDarkRoom. These are added resource-comparison figures; the reward/cost curves, rankings and ablation findings in Figures 1–2 and 4–6 are unchanged.

T1.justification: The formal problem, assumptions, Theorem 1, Proposition 1 and Appendix B proofs are unchanged. The correction of 'probabilities' in Appendix B.2 is typographical, and the new impact-statement qualifications do not revise the formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about pioneering safe ICRL, parameter-update-free adaptation, budget responsiveness, OOD benchmarks and fixed-point safety properties.

C2.justification: The Impact Statement newly specifies that applicability requires a CMDP representation, available cost signals and an appropriate CTG budget whose selection may require domain knowledge or calibration. v2 stated broader residual-risk cautions without these practical qualifications.

D1.justification: v3 adds an explicit code-release statement and repository link, plus environment-step and parameter-count disclosures for SafeDarkRoom. It also removes exact SCARED and Safe AD update counts rather than relocating them. Other implementation and hyperparameter details remain largely unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.3 adds two Xie et al. (2026) works as theoretical support for ICRL. Most other reference changes update publication metadata for already cited works; the substantive positioning against ICRL, safe RL and safe meta-RL remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Changes include localized training-description edits, a short budget-comparison paragraph, typo and author-name corrections, updated publication/reference metadata, and renaming and moving the Impact Statement before Acknowledgments. The overall section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: v3 adds a setup-summary Table 1, renumbers the existing hyperparameter tables, removes update-count rows and relocates the meta-RL table. Appendix text and Figure 4 shift within the layout, while the plotted content of Figures 1–6 remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 clarifies applicability, supplies a code-access link and adds useful setup and resource summaries. However, it removes exact SCARED and Safe AD update budgets without specifying a convergence criterion, and the new resource totals cover only SafeDarkRoom. With unchanged reward/cost evidence, these documentation gains and reproducibility losses leave the net quality effect uncertain.
